name: Liquid Glass JS
summary: WebGL library for Apple-style liquid glass effects with refraction, blur and masking.
description: A vanilla JavaScript library that renders glass elements on a canvas with real-time WebGL refraction, blur and masking. Provides container and button classes in three shapes (rounded rectangle, circle, pill), nested glass where child elements sample the parent's output, live-tunable glass parameters and semantic CSS classes for theming.
contains: three shape types: rounded rectangle, circle and pill/capsule
WebGL shaders: multi-layer edge, rim and base refraction with 13×13 blur sampling
nested glass: child elements sample the parent container output
live-tunable parameters: edge/rim/base intensity and distance, ripple, blur radius, tint opacity
container and button classes plus semantic CSS classes for theming
browser support: Chrome 80+, Firefox 75+, Safari 14+, Edge 80+ (WebGL 2.0)
